<style>
body { background-color: #fff8f0; font-family: 'Noto Serif SC', Georgia, serif; line-height: 1.8; max-width: 960px; }
#header { border-bottom: 2px solid #ff6b35; padding-bottom: 12px; }
.postTitle { color: #ff6b35; position: relative; padding-bottom: 14px; }
.postTitle::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 60px; height: 3px; background: #ff6b35; border-radius: 2px; }
#postBody { line-height: 1.9; }
#postBody h2 { border-bottom: 1px solid #d0d7de; padding-bottom: 8px; }
#postBody h3 { color: #ff6b35; }
#postBody table { border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #d0d7de; }
#postBody table th { background: #ff6b35; color: #fff; padding: 10px 16px; }
#postBody table td { padding: 8px 16px; }
#postBody table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background-color: #fff4ef; }
#postBody code { background: #fff4ef; border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 6px; color: #ff6b35; }
#postBody blockquote { border-left: 4px solid #ff6b35; background: #fff4ef; border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; padding: 12px 16px; margin: 16px 0; }
#footer { border-top: 1px solid #d0d7de; padding-top: 20px; color: #656d76; }
#footer a { color: #ff6b35; }
@media (max-width: 600px) { body { padding: 12px; } .postTitle { font-size: 24px; } }
</style>
